lines: Plant your feet! Terra-shaping isn't about moving rock; it's about being immovable!

terra_act1_02.stage_direction: Darkness overlay covers the quarry tiles
lines: People of the dust! Pay double tribute today, or we strip the roofs from your stone halls!
Rogue wind-kin... flying higher than our stone throws can reach!
Kid, go learn the speed of Pyre, the fluid reach of Tide, and the lift of Aether so we can ground them!
